p1: The Lord gave Hannah a baby boy! She named him Samuel. She said, “I asked the Lord for him.”
When Samuel was a little older, Hannah took him to the Lord’s house. She told Eli, “I prayed for this child, and the Lord gave him!”
Samuel would live there and help. Hannah kept her promise to the Lord.
p2: Hannah prayed, “My heart rejoices in the Lord!” She was so glad! She said, “There is no rock like the Lord.” A rock is strong and safe, and so is He. After that, Hannah came every year with a little coat she made for Samuel.
Your heart can be glad too. Tonight, thank Heavenly Father for one thing that makes you glad.
old: When Samuel was still a little boy, Hannah kept her promise. She brought Samuel to the temple. An old priest named Eli lived there.
Hannah said, “This is the son I prayed for. Now I’m giving him back to Heavenly Father to serve Him.” Samuel would live at the temple and help Eli.
Every year, Hannah came to visit Samuel. She brought him a new coat that she made. Samuel grew bigger and stronger each year.
Samuel was obedient and helpful. He learned to serve Heavenly Father from a young age. Hannah’s gift to God was her precious son.
